title: Additional Robots
description: Additional robots to load. Keys are robot names, values are robot module definitions or visual geometry. When specified at the top-level of the mc_rtc configuration (alongside MainRobot), the robots are loaded by every enabled controller. This can be overriden or extended on a per-controller basis by adding a 'robots' entry to the controller's own configuration.

module.description: Module name: this can be any robot module name, robot alias (such as env/ground or object/box), or any path supported by RobotLoader

init_pos.description: Initial position of the robot in the world frame.
Initial position of the robot in the world frame.
